description: Load a test case as NUMBERED steps to edit — from its recording JOURNAL when one exists (so a later journal_modify stays healer/re-record consistent), else from its persisted steps (the `source` is reported). Optional `pattern` filters shown rows (case-insensitive substring over the step description) to help locate a range for journal_modify. Requires a live connection.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over step descriptions.

tcId.description: Test case id or business key.

versionId.description: SimplifyQA, multi-version test cases: the version to read — its id or name (e.g. "v2.0"). Omit for the current version. Use the SAME value in journal_modify to edit that version.

name: journal_grep
title: Read a test case for editing (journal view)
